entries.name: composer is reachable and focusable
Shift+Enter inserts a newline, does not send
Enter sends the message
Stop button is keyboard-focusable and Enter-activatable
message action buttons become visible on keyboard focus (:focus-within), not just mouse hover
Copy action is Enter-activatable via keyboard
Edit opens an editable textarea reachable by keyboard
Escape cancels edit mode without changing the message
mode selector responds to ArrowDown (native <select> behavior)
mode selector is keyboard-reachable and operable
first focused element on dialog open
theme option button is Enter-activatable
theme option button is Space-activatable
focusable elements inside settings dialog
rename dialog auto-focuses its text input
dialog focus trap: Shift+Tab from the first control wraps to the last
dialog focus trap: Tab from the last control wraps to the first
Escape cancels the rename dialog (no dialog left open)
focus is restored to the rename button that opened the dialog, after Escape
Escape cancels the delete confirmation (nothing deleted)
Enter on the danger button confirms delete
Escape cancels Clear chat confirmation
Enter confirms Clear chat
opening the drawer via keyboard moves focus inside it (New Chat)
New Chat is among the drawer's real focusable controls (keyboard-reachable)
a disabled control (sign-in, when Firebase isn't configured) is excluded from the focus trap - not just visually inert
a hidden control (#logout-btn, inside #user-profile[hidden] in guest mode) is excluded from the focus trap, not just from the visual layout
Import (a <label>, not a <button>) is keyboard-focusable
Import is Enter-activatable via keyboard (opens the real file picker, not a mouse-only no-op)
keyboard order matches the approved layout: New Chat comes after search/history and before the utility controls
drawer focus trap: Shift+Tab from the true first control wraps to the true last
drawer focus trap: Tab from the true last control wraps to the true first
Escape closes the drawer
focus returns to the drawer toggle button after Escape
sign-in control is honestly disabled (not fake-enabled) when Firebase isn't configured
entries.detail: {"disabled":true,"statusText":"Sign-in is unavailable: Firebase is not configured for this app."}
